nodes.name: store.ts
nodes.summary: Svelte store module managing build state persistence, enchantment manipulation, guild/race configuration, and armor/ring slot reordering. Exports reactive stores and updater functions that form the central state management layer for the Voxel Blade damage calculator.

nodes.name: loadBuild
nodes.summary: Loads the persisted BuildState from localStorage, merges it with defaults via spread operator, and returns a complete BuildState. Uses defensive try/catch to fall back to defaults on parse errors or missing data.

nodes.name: setEnchantment
nodes.summary: Sets a single enchantment value at a given index within a specified armor slot. Delegates constraint enforcement (e.g. no duplicate enchantments) to the engine's enforceEnchantSlot function.

nodes.name: swapEnchantments
nodes.summary: Swaps the entire enchantment arrays between two different armor slots. Short-circuits if both slots are the same.

nodes.name: clearBuild
nodes.summary: Resets the entire build state to the DEFAULT_BUILD constant, effectively restoring all equipment, enchantments, and settings to initial values.

nodes.name: setGuild
nodes.summary: Sets the guild name and rank. Automatically forces the race to 'DRAGON BLOODED' and initializes draconic color if the guild is 'Draconic'; clears draconic fields otherwise.

nodes.name: moveArmorSlot
nodes.summary: Moves or clones an armor piece between a primary slot (helmet/chestplate/leggings) and its infusion counterpart. Validates slot compatibility via armorSupportsSlot, swaps or copies the upgrade level, and returns whether the move succeeded.

nodes.name: canArmorMoveToSlot
nodes.summary: Predicate that checks whether a given armor name is compatible with a target slot type (Helmet/Chestplate/Leggings) by delegating to armorSupportsSlot.

nodes.name: moveRingSlot
nodes.summary: Moves or clones a ring between the primary ring slot and its infusion counterpart, including the associated upgrade level. Follows the same clone-or-swap pattern as moveArmorSlot.

functions.name: getUnmetReqs

nodes.name: weaponArts.ts

nodes.name: damage-types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines all damage type metadata (labels, colors), defense inheritance mappings, type priority ordering, and exported constant arrays for the game's 11 damage types (physical, magic, fire, water, earth, air, hex, holy, true, summon, heal).

nodes.name: damageTypeResolve.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves weapon art damage types from string descriptions into numeric type maps, applies type bonuses, and performs damage type conversions (Fire<->Air via Echo Incineration, Air->Magic via Spirit Winds, Dark Magic hex bonus).

functions.name: resolveDamageTypes
functions.summary: Merges base damage types with bonus damage types by summing corresponding keys.

functions.name: applyFireAirConversion
functions.summary: Converts 50% of Fire damage to Air and 50% of Air damage to Fire (Echo Incineration).

functions.name: resolveWaDamageTypeKeys
functions.summary: Parses a weapon art's damage type string ('Same as weapon', 'Highest damage type', or explicit multi-type) into a numeric type map.

functions.name: getFinalWaDmgTypes
functions.summary: Combines resolveWaDamageTypeKeys with resolveDamageTypes to produce the final weapon art damage type distribution.

functions.name: applyAirToMagicConversion
functions.summary: Converts a fraction of Air to Magic (Spirit Winds), then applies Fire<->Air conversion (Echo Incineration), then adds Dark Magic hex bonus from native magic.

nodes.name: build.ts
nodes.summary: Core build calculation engine: accumulates stats and perks from all equipment slots (race, guild, armor, ring, rune, weapon), applies enchantments and infusions, finalizes perks with effectiveness scaling, computes CDR, boosts, crit, and assembles active buffs. Exports calcBuild as the main entry point.

functions.name: calcBuild
functions.summary: Main entry point: accumulates equipment stats/perks, finalizes perks, and derives the full BuildResult with boosted stats, CDR, boosts, and crit.

nodes.name: data.ts

nodes.name: enchant.ts
nodes.summary: Enchantment application engine: applies stat-selecting enchantments (Restored, Flawless), direct stat modifiers, perk modifiers, perk effectiveness scaling, infusion (50% stat halving), and exclusive enchant slot enforcement.

functions.name: applyEnchantmentsToSlot
functions.summary: Applies a list of enchantments to an equipment slot's base stats and perks, handling stat selectors, direct modifiers, perk modifiers, and upgrade levels.

functions.name: applyPerkEffectiveness
functions.summary: Scales all perks by (1 + PE * 0.1) * (1 + Cursed * 0.1), exempting enchant effects and certain special perks.

functions.name: applyInfusion
functions.summary: Halves all stats from an infused item (50% stat value) while keeping perks unchanged.

functions.name: isExclusiveEnchant
functions.summary: Returns true if the enchantment has stacking='exclusive' (takes over entire slot).

functions.name: enforceEnchantSlot
functions.summary: Enforces slot constraints: deduplicates, handles exclusive enchants, and compacts filled slots.

nodes.name: format.ts
nodes.summary: Formatting utilities for stat display: formats numeric stat values with +/- signs, percentage suffixes for percent-type stats, and converts camelCase stat keys to readable labels.

functions.name: formatStat

functions.name: formatLabel
functions.summary: Converts a camelCase stat key to a readable label (e.g., 'attackSpeed' -> 'Attack Speed').

nodes.name: shrine.ts
nodes.summary: Shrine multiplier system: defines tier-based stat multipliers (3.0x at tier 1 down to 1.0x at tier 5) and applies them to weapon stats and scalings when the shrine is active.

functions.name: applyShrineToScalings
functions.summary: Multiplies all scaling values by the shrine tier multiplier.

functions.name: applyShrineToStats
functions.summary: Multiplies all stat values by the shrine tier multiplier with rounding.

nodes.name: weapon.ts
nodes.summary: Weapon calculation engine: combines blade/handle (or glove/essence for monk) stats, scalings, damage types, and perks; resolves weapon type from handle+blade combo with perk overrides; detects hybrid bonus; applies shrine multipliers and monk rank bonuses. Exports calcWeapon and calcMonkWeapon.

functions.name: calcWeapon
functions.summary: Calculates the full WeaponResult for a standard (non-monk) weapon from blade and handle names, including merged stats, scalings, damage types, weapon type resolution, and hybrid detection.

functions.name: calcMonkWeapon
functions.summary: Calculates the full WeaponResult for a monk weapon from glove and essence names, applying monk rank stat bonuses on top of shrine-scaled stats.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: VoxelBlade is a web-based damage calculator and build optimizer for the Roblox game 'Voxel Blade'. It simulates weapon stats, enchantments, perks, and other game mechanics to calculate damage output and compare different builds. This Svelte 5 + TypeScript + Vite application is a single-page app served from index.html and mounted via src/main.ts. The README documents the recommended IDE setup (VS Code + Svelte extension), why plain Vite was chosen over SvelteKit, and TypeScript configuration decisions.

tour.title: Core Type Definitions
tour.description: Every module in the codebase imports from src/lib/types.ts — it is the most depended-upon file (12 importers) and defines the shared vocabulary: BuildState, equipment stats, perk interfaces, enchantment slots, damage type maps, and all game data structures. Understanding these types is essential before exploring any other layer, as they form the contract between the UI, engine, and data layers.

tour.title: Shared Utilities and Constants
tour.description: Two foundational modules sit beneath nearly everything else. src/lib/utils.ts (11 importers) provides rounding helpers, proc chance calculation, warding debuff math, and text highlighting. The src/lib/constants barrel re-exports over a dozen sub-modules — game-wide values (level caps, HP formulas, CDR values, damage type metadata, boost multipliers, and thresholds). Together they supply the numeric foundation for every calculation in the engine.
tour.languageLesson: TypeScript barrel files (index.ts re-exporting sub-modules) let consumers import from a single path (e.g. '@lib/constants') while keeping each constant domain in its own file for maintainability.

tour.title: Game Data Definitions
tour.description: The src/data directory contains both TypeScript modules and JSON schema files defining every game entity: 11 races, guilds with rank progressions, 100+ armors, blades, handles, essences, gloves, rings, runes, enchantments, and the massive perks.json (3,688 lines) that the entire damage engine references. These static datasets are loaded at build time and drive every calculation path in the application.
tour.languageLesson: JSON schema files in src/data/ serve as structured game data. They are not validated at runtime — instead, TypeScript types from types.ts define the expected shape, and Vite's static asset importing provides the data at build time.

tour.title: Engine Core — Build Calculation
tour.description: The engine orchestrator lives at src/lib/engine/build.ts — the file with the highest fan-out (16 dependencies). Its calcBuild function accumulates stats and perks from every equipment slot (race, guild, armor, ring, rune, weapon), applies enchantments and infusions, finalizes perks with effectiveness scaling, computes CDR, boosts, crit, and assembles active buffs. It imports from weapon.ts, enchant.ts, shrine.ts, data.ts, and dozens of data modules. This is the heart of the damage calculator.

tour.title: Weapon and Enchantment Engines
tour.description: Weapon calculation (src/lib/engine/weapon.ts) combines blade/handle stats, scalings, damage types, and perks — detecting hybrid bonuses and applying shrine multipliers. Monk weapons follow a separate path via calcMonkWeapon. The enchantment engine (src/lib/engine/enchant.ts) applies stat-selecting enchants (Restored/Flawless), direct modifiers, perk effectiveness scaling, and infusion's 50% stat halving. Both modules depend on the data barrel (engine/data.ts) for game entity lookups.

tour.title: Critical Hits, Defense, and Damage Types
tour.description: Three engine modules handle specific damage sub-systems. src/lib/crit.ts calculates crit chance and damage with perk-specific formulas (Flowing Crits, Sharp Crits, Thief Training, etc.). src/lib/defense.ts resolves armor defense breakdowns across damage types using the DEF_GROUP mapping. src/lib/damageTypeResolve.ts converts weapon art damage type strings into numeric maps, applying Fire↔Air conversion (Echo Incineration) and Air→Magic conversion (Spirit Winds). Together they complete the damage formula pipeline.
tour.languageLesson: The defense module exports a DEF_GROUP constant that maps each of the 11 damage types to its applicable defense stat — this pattern of mapping enums to subsets is common in game engines to avoid switch/case explosion.

tour.title: Buff and Boost Systems
tour.description: The buff system (src/data/BuffData.ts) assembles all active buffs from perks, weapon arts, and runes, calculating potency and duration with stacking rules. The boost system (src/data/Boost.ts) defines 30+ damage boosts (Blood Thirsty, Frenzy, Primal, Penance, Vampire) each with custom calcFn closures. TypedDmgBoost.ts aggregates per-damage-type multipliers from these boosts. These modules form the post-calculation damage amplification layer that sits on top of the raw engine output.
tour.languageLesson: Boost definitions use a factory pattern with calcFn closures — each boost captures its own calculation logic, allowing the boost system to handle both simple multiplier-per-perk values and complex conditional formulas without external branching.

tour.title: State Management with Svelte Stores
tour.description: src/lib/store.ts is the central state management layer (11 outgoing edges). It exports reactive Svelte stores for the entire build configuration and provides updater functions: loadBuild (localStorage deserialization with defaults fallback), setEnchantment (delegates to engine's enforceEnchantSlot), swapEnchantments, moveArmorSlot/moveRingSlot (clone-or-swap between primary and infusion slots), and setGuild (with race auto-override for Draconic). The store imports from the engine to validate enchantment constraints at write time.

tour.title: Main Application Component
tour.description: src/App.svelte is the root UI orchestrator (fan-out: 10). It composes the DamageAnalyzer, BuffList, LevelBar, EmotionalTracker, CdrStepsCalc, DraconicAbilityStats, and AppHeader — wiring each to the reactive store. It manages the Overview/Analyze tab switching and the overall layout. The component sits at the top of the import tree and is mounted by src/main.ts into the div#app element defined in index.html.

tour.title: Damage Display and Analysis UI
tour.description: The damage display layer consists of BaseDamageCalc (raw damage values from weapon stats), DamageAnalyzer (full breakdown by type with defense calculations), DmgTotalTooltip (pie chart of damage type distribution), and BuffList (active buff/debuff display). These components read computed values from the engine and render them with the project's custom UI components (Card, Badge, Stat, Panel from src/lib/ui/). The EmotionalTracker and CdrStepsCalc add interactive controls for situational modifiers.
tour.languageLesson: Svelte 5's $props() rune replaces the traditional props declaration. Components like Stat.svelte use $props() to destructure named props, enabling TypeScript inference for component interfaces without explicit prop type declarations.

tour.title: Modal System and Equipment Selection
tour.description: The modal system provides the build configuration interface. RaceModal, GuildModal, WeaponPartModal, and AccessorySelectModal each wrap their content in the reusable Modal component (with backdrop, focus trapping, and fly-in animation). ModalSearchHeader provides shared search, tag filtering, stat filtering, and suggestion dropdowns. BuildSaves (~1,100 lines) handles localStorage-based save slots with drag-to-reorder, export/import (compressed base64), and fuzzy search. This is where users configure their builds.

tour.title: Project Configuration and Deployment
tour.description: The project root contains the full build and deployment configuration. package.json defines the ESM project with Svelte 5, Vite 8, Vitest, and PWA support. The GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/static.yml) builds the project and deploys to GitHub Pages. Vercel is also configured for hosting. TypeScript configuration is split across tsconfig.json (IDE default), tsconfig.app.json (application source targeting ES2023), and tsconfig.node.json (build tooling). Fallow provides dead-code analysis and security scanning.
tour.languageLesson: VitePWA (configured in vite.config.ts) enables offline support via a service worker with StaleWhileRevalidate caching. The VITE_BASE_PATH env var allows the same build to deploy to different base paths (GitHub Pages subdirectory vs. Vercel root).
